#research question
Does the type of party show whether someone who uses AI will receive a professional sanction?
```{r}
hallucination_cases <- read.csv("hallucination_cases.csv")
```


```{r}
names(hallucination_cases)
head(hallucination_cases)
dim(hallucination_cases)
str(hallucination_cases)
table(hallucination_cases$`Professional Sanction`, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(hallucination_cases, aes(x = Professional.Sanction)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "cases by which profession",
    x = "professional santion",
    y = "cases"

```

#visualization
```{r}
ggplot(hallucination_cases, aes(x = Party.ies., fill = Professional.Sanction)
) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "Profession",

```
```{r}
colSums(is.na(hallucination_cases))
sort(table(hallucination_cases$Party.ies., useNA = "ifany"),
     decreasing = TRUE)
table(hallucination_cases$`Professional Sanction`, useNA = "ifany")
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
hallucination_cases %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Party.ies.),
    !is.na(Professional.Sanction)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Party.ies.) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cases = n(),
    Sanctioned_Cases = sum(Professional.Sanction== "Yes"),
    Sanction_Rate = mean(Professional.Sanction== "Yes") * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Sanction_Rate))
```


#fit and interpret decision tree
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(caret)
tree <- hallucination_cases %>%
  select(Party.ies., Professional.Sanction) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Party.ies.),
    !is.na(Professional.Sanction)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Party = factor(Party.ies.),
    Sanction = factor(
      Professional.Sanction,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Party, Sanction)
set.seed(123)
train_index <- createDataPartition(
  tree$Sanction,
  p = 0.80,
  list = FALSE
)
train_data <- tree[train_index, ]
test_data <- tree[-train_index, ]
nrow(train_data)
nrow(test_data)
table(train_data$Sanction)
table(test_data$Sanction)
```
```{r}
decision <- rpart(
  Sanction ~ Party,
  data = train_data,
  method = "class",
  control = rpart.control(
    cp = 0.005,
    minbucket = 10
  )
)
rpart.plot(
  decision, type = 3, extra = 104, fallen.leaves = TRUE, main = "Decision Tree for party and its connection to professional sanction"
)

predictions <- predict(
  decision, newdata = test_data, type = "class"
)
confusionMatrix(
  data = factor(predictions, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
  reference = test_data$Sanction,
  positive = "Yes"
)
```
```{r}
print(decision)
```

#random forest
```{r}
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
set.seed(123)
forest <- randomForest(
  Sanction ~ Party,
  data = train_data,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)
forest
```
```{r}
forestpredict <- predict(
  forest,
  newdata = test_data,
  type = "class"
)
table(forestpredict)
confusionMatrix(
  data = factor(forestpredict, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
  reference = test_data$Sanction,
  positive = "Yes"
)
```
